Description content: Agree on Subject Request, Brief, Outcomes, Research Dossier, question and choice boundaries, stable IDs, and producer/consumer fixtures before implementation begins.

Task Name: Subject Request and Course Brief v0.2 contracts
Description content: Add and test schemas and fixtures for the sparse subject request and approved Course Brief, including required, optional, conditional, assumption, and provenance fields.
Implement provider-independent typed questions and choices with stable IDs, answer types, defaults, conditional display, validation, recommendations, and single or multiple selection.

Task Name: Terminal interaction renderer and test responder
Description content: Render typed questions and choices in the console and provide an injectable scripted responder so interaction tests run deterministically without an LLM.
Build deterministic Course Brief questions plus bounded validated follow-ups, preserve resolved answers, expose assumptions, and emit a schema-valid Brief.

Task Name: Course Outcomes agent and outcome choices
Description content: Generate measurable outcomes and let the user select, reject, edit, add, and reprioritize them while blocking research when no meaningful outcome is approved.

Extend and test the Research Dossier for extracted competitor outlines, original order and locators, normalized topics, coverage and sequence analysis, structural implications, and factual-source candidates.
Define testable search, fetch, extract, and source-store interfaces with a mocked provider and explicit failure results so research logic is not tied to one vendor.

Task Name: Competitor outline extraction and normalization prototype
Description content: Convert fixture competitor outlines into ordered sections and normalized topics, preserve original labels, and generate a coverage-matrix fixture.
Persist approved source content or excerpts by stable course and source ID, validate locators and content references, and represent unavailable sources explicitly.
Apply human-selected IDs to proposed candidates as approved or rejected without LLM interpretation and prove rejected or proposed sources cannot enter the downstream registry.
Run scripted interaction into mocked research proposals and resolve schema or interface drift before the Sprint 1 gate.
Demonstrate sparse request to approved Brief and Outcomes, display a mocked candidate-source form, apply source choices deterministically, and leave all regression tests green.
Add ambiguity and conflict checks with no more than three validated follow-ups, rejecting repeated or out-of-stage agent questions and using a cheaper model configuration where available.
Generate course-wide defaults and per-subtopic depth, time, word range, concept, example, case, assessment, asset, and source-routing plans against the agreed Course Model contract.
Let the user accept global defaults, select or reject assets, and override meaningful per-subtopic exceptions without completing a blank form for every subtopic.
Validate ranges, selected assets, concept and source references, and confirmation for subtopics without a core content asset, including negative tests.
Wire intake, outcomes, approved research, Course Model, and Blueprint into the runnable pipeline and prove rejected upstream stages rerun without losing unrelated approvals.

Task Name: Live bounded search and fetch provider
Description content: Implement one live provider behind the research adapter with accessible HTML and practical text-PDF support, bounded retries, and actionable failures.

Find five to eight relevant offerings, require at least three usable outlines, extract ordered TOCs, normalize topics, and produce coverage, sequence, gap, and differentiation analysis without inventing hidden content.
Propose auditable factual sources with trust and relevance notes, ingest only human-approved content, support manual additions, and report evidence gaps.
Generate modules, subtopics, scope, dependencies, concepts, coverage, approved source mappings, and compact structural rationale from the approved upstream artifacts.
Reject proposed, rejected, or unavailable source leakage, invalid IDs and dependencies, unresolved outcomes, and embedded full evidence, with negative tests.

Task Name: Live-provider and Course Model contract review
Description content: Inspect one real research result together and approve any necessary bounded contract adjustment before downstream integration.
Run approved source choices through the Course Model and Blueprint and verify that structural rationale and per-subtopic decisions remain traceable.

Demonstrate sparse request through live competitor and source research, reject at least one source, approve the Course Model, choose different subtopic plans, and produce an approved Blueprint without source leakage.
Coordinate sequential execution across approved subtopic plans, expose the current stage, subtopic, and asset, and preserve completed work without embedding domain logic.
Resume approved stages and completed assets, display pending or failed units, and support safe retry without deleting unrelated artifacts.

Task Name: Domain-neutral Lesson Plan contract and agent
Description content: Replace the FRM fixture with a validated agent that collects unresolved session constraints and produces sessions, durations, modes, covered subtopics, and talking points.
Render every selected asset, course overview, source index, and Lesson Plan into deterministic organized paths without claiming native DOCX or PPTX files exist.

Task Name: Run summary and mocked end-to-end test
Description content: Record completed, skipped, failed, and pending-review stages, token and cost references, and output paths, then run a fully mocked modest course through folder generation.

Task Name: Generalize Student Content to all planned subtopics
Description content: Remove fixed FRM subtopic assumptions, derive stable asset identities from Course Model and Blueprint data, and generate only selected assets across the acceptance course.
Build context slices for arbitrary module and subtopic IDs using course context, neighbor summaries, Blueprint requirements, and only approved assigned evidence.
Block unselected assets and proposed, rejected, or unassigned sources deterministically and return an evidence-gap state instead of drafting unsupported facts.
Verify every generated factual asset, surface results by subtopic, and revise one target without regenerating unaffected assets.

Task Name: Partial failure, cache, and retry behavior
Description content: Preserve successful assets when a call fails, retry within bounds, reuse unchanged cache entries, and expose a recoverable pending state to the coordinator.
Run two subtopics early and fix ID, selection, context, and resume boundary defects before expanding to the full acceptance course.
Force one generation failure and one targeted human revision and prove that completed unrelated work remains intact.
Produce exactly the selected assets for an approved four-to-eight-subtopic Blueprint, verification results, a basic Lesson Plan, Markdown deliverables, and a resumable run summary.
Run the agreed non-FRM course from sparse request through folder output and exercise clarification, outcome, source, and asset choices, competitor scanning, targeted revision, and resume.
Improve prompts, defaults, validation messages, cancellation, and summaries based on the live acceptance run without introducing a new UI framework.
Make filenames, indexes, course overview, source index, status reporting, and rerun behavior deterministic and understandable.
Correct generic scheduling or timing defects found in acceptance and ensure every planned subtopic is covered exactly where intended.
Document and test stop, quit, resume, rejection, retry, and targeted-revision behavior from an operator's perspective.
Write a minimal setup and run guide plus a concise demonstration script using the actual accepted output.

Task Name: Live research and TOC acceptance fixes
Description content: Fix only bounded search, extraction, normalization, source capture, and insufficient-evidence defects exposed by the primary live run.

Task Name: Live whole-course content and verification fixes
Description content: Complete acceptance generation and repair generic evidence routing, IDs, verification, cache, or targeted-revision defects without subject-specific prompt rules.
Run a substantially different topic through Course Model and Blueprint plus a small selected-content slice without changing reusable code or prompts.
Prove rejected-source, unselected-asset, invalid-ID, insufficient-evidence, and hidden competitor-content failures are blocked.
Review all artifacts and outputs together, classify only prototype-blocking defects as required, and preserve the approved scope boundary.
Reserve one full focused day for unpredictable live research, model-output, cross-artifact, or rendering failures; use it for stretch work only if the final gate already passes.

Confirm the primary course and second-topic smoke pass, regression tests are green, rejected sources and assets cannot leak, the course folder is complete, resume works, and the operator guide is accurate.
